limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).

8 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools: 醜 にくむ (悪 憎), 醜 たぐい (双 類), 釈 しゃ (予 写 射 左 捨 砂 社 者 and three more; KANJIDIC2 name reading), 釈 おく (億 屋 憶), 鎖 さす (刺 射 差 指 挿 止 注 点), 附 ぶ (不 分 夫 武 歩 舞 豊 部), 陰 おん (御) and 陰 くらい (位 夢 暗); 釈 しゃ is a KANJIDIC2 name reading, and the others come from the --extra list.

reading_options.py reports two problems, 醜 たぐい (by 双 or 類) and 釈 おく (by 億, 屋 or 憶), both from the --extra list; it does not model curated slots, and reading_exposure.py shows neither reading can be drawn in any checked pool, because the curated Starter options of 醜 (短 赤 新) and 釈 (書 聞 学) fill every wrong slot.
3 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (no JMdict entry id: 日陰, 醜い, 鑑賞) are pre-existing and out of scope.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed. Six cards quiz only their on reading (釈 シャク, 銃 ジュウ, 銭 セン, 鑑 カン, 附 フ, 陥 カン) and nine only their kun reading (酌 く.む, 酔 よ.う, 酢 す, 醜 みにく.い, 釣 つ.る, 鈴 すず, 鎖 くさり, 鐘 かね, 陰 かげ).

酔っ払い, 釣り and 釣り合う use the readings 酔 よ and 釣 つ.り and つ.り-, which share a stem with the quizzed よ.う and つ.る; the app asks one question per stem, so these articles are linked on their own rows, which are not quizzed.
Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.

Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options, except where a Notes bullet on the card says otherwise. The two pairs of new cards that exclude each other declare it on one card only (鈴 lists 鐘, and 陥 lists 釣, added in review), and every exclusion between a new and an existing card is declared on the new card; the app's QuizBuilder applies an exclusion in both directions.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology; component and stroke statements follow the pinned KanjiVG revision.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.
The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they can list files as unread that the reports say were read.
Several judgments rest partly on live reads of Kanjipedia, Digital Daijisen, Jisho and kanjiapi.dev pages, not on pinned copies in the packet.

The confirmation reviewers did not re-run the audits; they judged the check outputs that the author ran on the revised snapshot and included in their packets. Neither reopened the eleven unchanged cards in full.
The fix was first committed as 4accddbf and amended to 3f8b951d before either confirmation, adding the spelling ×鏁 to the headword quoted on 鎖 line 43; 4accddbf was never pushed or reviewed.
